title: Los Angeles RSO annual allowable rent increase (2025-2026)
requirement: A landlord of an RSO-covered rental unit may raise rent by no more than 3% between July 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, no additional percentage increase for utilities may be included.
coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); non-RSO properties are excluded.
exemptions: Units not subject to the RSO (non-RSO properties); the page directs those landlords to the Housing Department for allowable increases.
citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. §151.00 et seq.)
quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026 is 3%.
